mostWorthwhile.text: Making pigment and using it to paint a remembered animal connected a physical material with communication through images.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment was a straightforward preparation rather than an interesting decision on its own.

surprise.text: The cave's echo became the basis for a song through remembering and repeating sounds in a rhythm.

arbitrary.text: Adding stars was visually clear, but the goal did not explain why they needed to be included in the animal painting.

continue.text: I would consider another chapter: the links between materials, sound and shared learning were engaging, although the compatible-choice menu left little discovery of recipes.
